title: How To Create A Modal - Pop Up Box
breadcrumbs: How To Create A Modal - Pop Up Box
content:
## How To Create A Modal - Pop Up Box Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052780 This article demonstrates how to create a basic modal pop-up that can display custom content on a website. The example uses a custom widget to define the modal's HTML and JavaScript, then displays it on a selected page. Note This example provides a basic modal template. Some content, such as signup forms or other interactive elements, may require additional customization to function correctly inside a modal. For a walkthrough of this feature, see the following Webinar: Create Pop-Up Notifications & Offer Boxes on Your Website – Training Workshop for Directory Software ## Step 1: Create the Modal Widget Create a new widget by navigating to: Toolbox → Widget Manager → New Widget ### Add the HTML Paste the following code into the widget's HTML editor. ```
 
   
     
               

Thank you for visiting us!

     
     
        Happy Holidays!      
     
             
   
 
``` The primary areas of the modal that can be customized are: - Title - Body Content ### Add the JavaScript Paste the following code into the widget's JavaScript editor. ``` ``` ## Step 2: Display the Modal Call the widget on the page where the modal should appear. For instructions on adding widgets to a page, see: How to Call a Widget on a Custom Page In this example, the widget is added to the /join page.
